blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Generative Pre-Training (GPT) represents a profound milestone in natural language processing, serving as the foundation for most of today's state-of-the-art large language models. By casting diverse understanding and generation problems into a shared token representation, GPT enables a single architecture and unified optimization loop to master heterogeneous tasks across massive corpora, giving rise to powerful foundation models for natural language. In contrast, 4D spatiotemporal vision lacks a common representational protocol: perception (such as depth and camera estimation) and generation are either handled by separate one-way pipelines or bolted together from unaligned single-modality spaces. In this work, we introduce WorldLatent, a framework that formulates a unified 4D latent space as a common protocol for both world perception and generation. Rather than relying on fragmented, task-specific models or stacked single-modality representations, our framework proposes a multimodal VAE architecture that compresses and fuses complex 4D visual appearance, geometry, and dynamics into a single structured latent representation. Within this formulation, perception and generation operate as complementary denoising processes over the same latent space, enabling one generative model to learn both capabilities simultaneously within a single training loop. Experiments across representative 4D benchmarks verify that our fused latent protocol achieves specialist-level zero-shot 4D perception, coherent 4D generation, and controllable editing from a single model. By demonstrating that diverse 4D tasks can be seamlessly unified under a shared representational protocol, our work provides a scalable foundation for general-purpose 4D spatial intelligence.
blocks.zh: Generative Pre-Training(GPT)代表了自然语言处理的一个深刻里程碑,是当今大多数最先进的大语言模型的基础. GPT通过将不同的理解和生成问题投放到一个共同的代号代表中,使得一个单一的架构和统一优化的循环能够掌握跨大块体的异形任务,从而产生了强大的自然语言基础模型. 相比之下,4D spatiotemporal视觉缺乏一个共同的表示协议:感知(如深度和相机估计)和生成要么通过单独的单向管道处理,要么从不协调的单模式空间中栓在一起. 在这项工作中,我们引入了WorldLatent,这个框架将一个统一的4D潜伏空间作为世界认知和一代的共同协议. 我们的框架不依靠零散、具体任务模式或堆叠的单一模式表示,而是提出一种将复杂的4D视觉外观、几何和动态压缩和引信成单一结构化潜在表示的多式联运VAE结构。 在这个配方中,感知和生成是在同一潜在空间上互补的消音过程,使一个基因模型能够在单一的培训循环中同时学习两种能力。 跨越具有代表性的4D基准的实验证实,我们的熔化潜在协议实现了专家级的零射4D感知,一致的4D生成,以及从单一模型中可控制的编辑. 通过展示多种4D任务在共享代表协议下可以无缝统一,我们的工作为通用4D空间智能提供了可扩展的基础.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The establishment of a unified task protocol in Generative Pre-Training (GPT) [ 41 , 42 , 5 ] marked a transformative milestone in natural language processing. Rather than relying on specialized architectures and loss functions [ 27 , 52 , 48 , 10 ] for text classification, machine translation, question answering, and open-ended synthesis, casting these diverse problems into a shared token representation enabled a single model to learn both understanding and generation within one optimization objective. Inspired by this success, we argue that achieving general-purpose 4D spatial intelligence in computer vision requires a similar unification: an intelligent visual system must not only perceive the 3D geometry and camera motion of a dynamic scene from video, but also imagine, synthesize, and edit coherent 4D worlds over time. Yet, in contrast to language modeling, 4D spatiotemporal vision still lacks such a common representational protocol.
blocks.zh: 在Generative Pre-Training(GPT)[41,42,5]中建立统一的任务协议,标志着自然语言处理的一个变革性里程碑. 与其依赖专门的架构和损失函数[27、52、48、10]进行文字分类、机器翻译、提问回答和开放式综合,不如将这些不同的问题放在一个共同的象征性表述中,使一个单一的模型能够在一个优化目标内学习理解和生成。 受这一成功所启发,我们主张在计算机视觉中实现通用的4D空间智能需要类似的统一:智能视觉系统必须不仅能从视频中感知动态场景的3D几何和相机运动,而且能想象,合成,并编辑相容的4D世界随时间推移. 然而,与语言建模不同,4D sparotemporal视觉仍然缺乏这种共同的代表协议.

blocks.en: As illustrated in Figure 1 (a), contemporary 4D perception and video generation still rely on separate one-way pipelines or unaligned, stacked modality spaces. On the perception side, feed-forward geometric reconstructors [ 59 , 30 , 70 , 58 , 57 , 31 ] and diffusion-based depth or pose estimators [ 25 , 19 , 65 , 69 ] , including recent adaptations of video generators for geometry estimation [ 22 , 51 ] , map videos to depth, point clouds, or camera trajectories, yet overwrite or omit RGB generation and cannot synthesize new visual worlds. On the generation side, large-scale video Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) [ 4 , 67 , 55 ] synthesize compelling imagery in 2D RGB latent spaces without explicit 3D grounding, geometry-guided generators [ 46 , 61 ] inject external 3D caches or feature alignment unidirectionally while still decoding solely into 2D pixels. Even recent frameworks that jointly diffuse appearance and geometry within one backbone [ 72 , 78 , 28 ] bypass multimodal tokenizer learning, heuristically passing geometric maps through frozen RGB Variational Autoencoders (VAEs) and concatenating disjoint latents. Bridging these two paradigms properly is non-trivial: geometric estimation methods seek representations that capture high-level structural abstraction to infer scene geometry and camera motions, whereas video generation models rely on generative compression that preserves low-level photometric details for high-fidelity visual reconstruction. This tension between geometric abstraction and generative compression motivates learning a genuinely fused representation rather than stacking separate latents.
blocks.zh: 如图1(a)所示,当代的4D感知和视频生成仍然依赖单独的单向管道或不相通的叠加模式空间. 在知觉方面,向导几何重建器[59,30,70,58,57,31]和以传播为主的深度或形成估计器[25,19,65,69],包括最近为几何估计而改编的视频生成器[22,51],地图视频到深度,指向云,或相机轨迹,但覆盖或忽略了RGB世代,无法合成新的视觉世界. 在生成方面,大规模视频 Difmusion Transformers (DiTs) [4, 67, 55] 在2D RGB 潜入空间中合成有说服力的图像,没有明确的3D地平面,几何-导出器 [46, 61] 向外注入3D缓存或特性单向对齐,而同时仍然仅被解码为2D像素. 即使是最近一些框架,在一个主干内共同扩散外观和几何特征[72、78、28],绕过多式示意器的学习,用冷冻的RGB变形自动编码器(VAEs)以直率通过几何图来传递,并调和脱节的潜想。 将这两个范式适当相接是非三相的:几何估计方法寻求能够捕捉高层次结构抽象来推断出场景几何和相机运动的表示,而视频生成模型则依靠基因压缩来保存低水平的光度测量细节来进行高真实性的视觉重建. 几何抽象和基因压缩之间的这种张力促使人们学会一种真正结合的表示,而不是堆放单独的潜伏物。

blocks.en: In this work, we take a step toward scaling general-purpose 4D spatial intelligence by tackling the fundamental question: “How can diverse knowledge of 4D world perception and generation be consolidated into a single generative model with a shared multi-task training loop?” Inspired by task unification in large language models, we seek a shared 4D representational protocol across visual appearance, geometry, and dynamics to bridge these capabilities.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们采取了一个步骤,通过解决以下基本问题,扩大通用4D空间情报: “如何将关于4D世界认知和生成的多种知识合并为一个单一的基因模型,并共享多任务培训循环?” 在大语言模型中的任务统一激励下,我们寻求一个跨越视觉外观,几何和动态的共享的4D代表协议,来连接这些能力.

blocks.en: To realize this protocol, we introduce WorldLatent (Figure 1 (b)), a framework that establishes a unified 4D latent space as a shared spatiotemporal representation for world perception and generation. Rather than relying on one-way pipelines or stacking unaligned modality latents, WorldLatent parameterizes a dynamic scene jointly via RGB video, dense depth, and pixel-aligned camera ray maps. To reconcile geometric structure with high-fidelity appearance compression, we design a multimodal 4D Variational Autoencoder (VAE) that compresses and fuses these modalities into a single spatiotemporal latent grid at the same token resolution as standard video VAEs.
blocks.zh: 为了实现这项协议,我们引入了WorldLatent(图1(b)),这个框架建立了统一的4D潜在空间,作为世界认知和一代的共同瞬间代表. WorldLatent不依靠单向管道或堆放不相通模式潜伏物,而是通过RGB视频,密集深度和相像相通相机射线图,将动态场景联合进行参数化. 为了调和几何结构与高纯度外观压缩,我们设计了一台多式4D变相自动编码器(VAE),以标准VAEs的同分分辨率将这些模式压缩并导出为单一的相位潜格.

blocks.en: Built upon this shared representation, WorldLatent unifies perception, generation, and controllable editing as complementary Any-to-4D denoising processes within a single generative model: (1) Any-to-4D Perception (RGB → \rightarrow Full 4D Latent), which conditions on an uncalibrated monocular video and denoises the full 4D latent to recover depth, dynamic 3D point clouds, and camera trajectories, (2) Any-to-4D Generation (Text → \rightarrow Full 4D Latent), which jointly denoises appearance, depth, and camera rays from noise to synthesize coherent videos paired with aligned 3D scene geometry and camera motion, and (3) Any-to-4D Editing and Rendering (Depth + Text → \rightarrow Full 4D Latent), which conditions on 4D depth structure and text prompts to render or edit visual appearance with strict 3D geometric adherence. Because every capability operates over the same latents with identical input and output spaces, a generative backbone can be adapted into a general-purpose 4D world model within a single multi-task training loop across perception and generation.

blocks.en: We instantiate and validate WorldLatent on a 14B-parameter generative model trained jointly across 4D perception, generation, and controllable editing. Evaluating across indoor, outdoor, and dynamic 4D benchmarks (MPI Sintel [ 6 ] , Bonn [ 40 ] , and ScanNet [ 9 ] ) as well as text-to-4D and depth-guided synthesis, we show that our fused 4D latent representation enables joint multi-task denoising within a single model, delivering strong geometric estimation, faithful geometry-guided rendering, and coherent 4D generation over a shared input-and-output latent space.
blocks.zh: 我们通过一个14B参数的基因模型, 通过4D感知、生成和可控编辑, 来对WorldLatent进行即时和验证。 在整个室内、室外和动态四维基准(MPI Sintel [6]、波恩[40]和ScanNet[9])以及文字至4D和深度指导合成中进行评估,我们显示,我们已连接的四维潜在代表能够在一个单一模型中联合开展多任务去除,提供强几何估计、忠实的几何指导渲染,以及一致的四维代在共享的输入和输出潜在空间之上。

blocks.en: In summary, our main contributions are threefold: • We propose WorldLatent, a unified 4D latent protocol for world perception and generation, employing a multimodal VAE to compress and fuse 4D visual appearance, geometry, and dynamics into a single shared latent space for diverse downstream 4D tasks. • We formulate a unified Any-to-4D generative modeling paradigm that consolidates 4D perception, generation, and editing into a single model with a shared multi-task training loop over the WorldLatent representation. • Across controlled ablations and a 14B-parameter unified model, we demonstrate that a single generative model trained on WorldLatent effectively supports dynamic 4D perception, 4D scene generation, and controllable neural rendering, establishing a scalable foundation for general-purpose 4D spatial intelligence.
blocks.zh: 总而言之,我们的主要贡献有三: 我们提出WorldLatent,一个统一的用于世界感知和生成的4D潜入协议,使用多式VAE来压缩和将4D视觉外观,几何和动态连接成一个单一的共享潜入空间,用于不同的下游4D任务. ^ 我们制定了统一的Any-to-4D基因模型模式,将4D感知、生成和编辑合并为一个单一模型,并有一个共享的多任务培训循环,覆盖WorldLatent代表。 · 纵观受控活化和14B参数统一模型,我们证明,一个经WorldLatent培训的单一基因模型有效支持了动态4D感知,4D场景生成,以及可控神经渲染,为通用4D空间智能奠定了可扩展的基础.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 3D and 4D Spatiotemporal Perception. Feed-forward pointmap regressors [ 59 , 57 , 31 , 30 ] predict 3D point clouds without structure-from-motion, with extensions to dynamic and streaming videos [ 70 , 58 ] . Meanwhile, monocular [ 66 , 8 ] and diffusion [ 25 , 19 , 49 ] depth models recover 2.5D depth without camera poses, and video-diffusion adaptations [ 65 , 22 , 51 ] estimate multi-frame 3D/4D geometry.
blocks.zh: 3D和4D Spatiotemporal Perception. 中国植物物种信息数据库. feed-forward pointmap recoverers [59, 57, 31, 30] 预测3D点云无结构-从-motion,并扩展至动态和流视频 [70, 58]. 同时,单体 [66,8] 和扩散 [25,19,49] 深度模型在没有相机姿势的情况下恢复了2.5D深度,并进行了视频分流适应[65,22,51] 估计多帧3D/4D几何.

blocks.en: Video and 4D World Generation. Video DiTs [ 4 , 67 , 55 ] lack 3D grounding in RGB latents, causing static-camera bias or drift. Conditioned generators inject camera, depth, or 3D cache cues [ 16 , 71 , 11 , 46 ] , or align features to geometric teachers [ 61 ] , unidirectionally without inferring 4D geometry, while dedicated 4D generators [ 62 , 2 , 32 , 64 , 13 ] remain synthesis specialists. Although WVD [ 72 ] and Aether [ 78 ] jointly diffuse appearance and geometry, WVD targets image-conditioned static scenes and Aether drops text conditioning on synthetic-only data, neither supports general-purpose multi-task learning across open-world 4D perception, generation, and editing under a unified representation protocol.
blocks.zh: 视频与4D世界世代. Video DiTs [4, 67, 55] 缺乏3D在RGB潜伏中地基,导致静相机偏差或漂移. 有条件的发电机注入相机,深度,或3D缓存提示 [16,71,11,46],或与几何教师对齐特征 [61],单向不推断出4D几何,而专用的4D发电机[62,2,32,64,13]仍然是合成专家. 虽然WVD [72]和Aether [78] 共同扩散外观和几何特征,但WVD针对的是图像条件化的静态场景,而Aether则放弃了仅以合成数据为主的文本条件,两者都不支持通用多任务学习,跨越开放世界的4D感知,生成,以及根据统一代表协议进行编辑.

blocks.en: Unified Multi-Task Representation Protocols. Inspired by unified task protocols in NLP [ 42 ] and multimodal vision [ 37 , 38 , 3 ] , recent works explore joint latent spaces: Orchid [ 29 ] encodes RGB, depth, and normals for static 2D images, requiring separate image-conditioned fine-tuning for perception, while MotionCrafter [ 79 ] learns a 4D geometry-and-motion VAE without visual synthesis. In 4D world modeling, joint frameworks [ 72 , 78 , 28 ] heuristically stack frozen RGB-VAE and geometric channels, retaining cross-modal redundancy and rigid modality boundaries. Instead, WorldVAE fuses RGB video, depth, and camera rays into a single compact bottleneck at an RGB-only VAE’s token count, enabling the unification of 4D perception, generation, and editing within one model and multi-task training.
blocks.zh: 统一的多任务代表协议. 受NLP[42]和多式联运愿景[37、38、3]的统一任务协议的启发,近期的作品探索了共同的潜在空间: Orchid [29] 编码了静态2D图像的RGB,深度和常态,需要单独进行图像条件的微调来进行感知;而MotionCr后 [79] 学习了没有视觉合成的4D几何和动能VAE. 在4D世界建模中,联合框架[72,78,28]高压堆放冷冻RGB-VAE和几何通道,保留了跨模式冗余和刚性模式边界. 而WorldVAE则将RGB的视频,深度和相机射线装入一个单一的紧凑瓶颈,在只使用RGB的VAE符号计数中,使得4D感知,生成和编辑统一在一个模型和多任务训练中.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Our goal is to establish a unified representational protocol that bridges 4D physical perception and generative modeling within a single model and a single optimization loop. As illustrated in Figure 2 , our WorldLatent training pipeline consists of two stages: (a) Unified 4D Latent Space via multimodal WorldVAE training and (b) Unified Any-to-4D Generative Modeling via WorldLatent diffusion training.
blocks.zh: 我们的目标是建立一个统一的表达协议,将4D物理感知和基因模型在单一模型和单一优化循环中相接. 如图2所显示的,我们的世界卫星培训管道包括两个阶段:(a) 通过多式世界甚高频教育培训,统一4D后期空间;(b) 通过世界卫星传播培训,统一An-4D基因模型。

blocks.en: 3.1 WorldLatent: Unified 4D Latent Space

Spatiotemporal 4D Modality Representation. A dynamic 3D scene observed over T T frames at spatial resolution H × W H\times W comprises visual appearance, 3D scene geometry, and camera motion.
To align all modalities onto a common spatiotemporal grid, we parameterize camera trajectories using dense Plücker ray coordinates [ 69 ] . For each pixel ( u , v ) (u,v) at frame t t , its camera ray is uniquely defined by a unit ray direction 𝐝 t , u , v ∈ ℝ 3 \mathbf{d}_{t,u,v}\in\mathbb{R}^{3} and a ray moment 𝐦 t , u , v = 𝐨 t × 𝐝 t , u , v ∈ ℝ 3 \mathbf{m}_{t,u,v}=\mathbf{o}_{t}\times\mathbf{d}_{t,u,v}\in\mathbb{R}^{3} , where 𝐨 t ∈ ℝ 3 \mathbf{o}_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{3} denotes the camera optical center in world coordinates. Thus, any 4D scene is represented by four spatiotemporally aligned tensors:
(1) Visual Appearance (RGB Video): 𝐗 1 = 𝐈 ∈ ℝ T × H × W × 3 \mathbf{X}_{1}=\mathbf{I}\in\mathbb{R}^{T\times H\times W\times 3} ,
(2) Scene Geometry (4D Depth Map): 𝐗 2 = 𝐃 ∈ ℝ T × H × W × 1 \mathbf{X}_{2}=\mathbf{D}\in\mathbb{R}^{T\times H\times W\times 1} ,
(3) Camera Ray Direction: 𝐗 3 = 𝐝 ∈ ℝ T × H × W × 3 \mathbf{X}_{3}=\mathbf{d}\in\mathbb{R}^{T\times H\times W\times 3} , and
(4) Camera Ray Moment: 𝐗 4 = 𝐦 ∈ ℝ T × H × W × 3 \mathbf{X}_{4}=\mathbf{m}\in\mathbb{R}^{T\times H\times W\times 3} .

As shown in Figure 2 (a), each modality 𝐗 i \mathbf{X}_{i} ( i ∈ { 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 } i\in\{1,2,3,4\} ) is first processed by a dedicated spatiotemporal encoder E i E_{i} , yielding modality-specific latent features 𝐟 i = E i ​ ( 𝐗 i ) ∈ ℝ T ′ × H ′ × W ′ × C \mathbf{f}_{i}=E_{i}(\mathbf{X}_{i})\in\mathbb{R}^{T^{\prime}\times H^{\prime}\times W^{\prime}\times C} downsampled by temporal and spatial factors ( f t , f s f_{t},f_{s} ) to the resolution T ′ × H ′ × W ′ T^{\prime}\times H^{\prime}\times W^{\prime} and the latent channel C C . Partial WorldLatent Encoding and Decoding. Leveraging the flexibility of our DPT token fusion mechanism, we apply random modality-level token masking during training, where unprovided modality streams are replaced with learnable mask tokens prior to fusion. blocks.en: Shared Representation for Multi-Task Perception and Generation. As shown in Figure 2 (b), both the conditioning input space and the target output space of our unified diffusion model reside entirely within the unified 4D latent space across all 4D perception and generation tasks. Consequently, regardless of the downstream task, the optimization target of the diffusion model remains identical: synthesizing the complete WorldLatent representation 𝐳 4 ​ d \mathbf{z}_{4d} , which encodes the full 4D world state.

blocks.en: Implementation Details. WorldVAE initializes all four encoder-decoder pairs from the Wan VAE [ 55 ] , freezing the encoders while fine-tuning the decoders alongside a 20M-parameter DPT Fusion module. blocks.en: We first evaluate the representational capacity and computational efficiency of WorldVAE in Table 1 . A naive approach to joint 4D generation is to tokenize RGB, depth, and camera rays as separate latent streams, which triples the sequence length ( 15,360 15{,}360 vs. 5,120 5{,}120 DiT tokens) and incurs a 3.84 × 3.84\times computational overhead ( 569.1 569.1 vs. 148.1 148.1 TFLOPs per NFE on a 14B DiT) due to quadratic self-attention scaling. In contrast, WorldVAE fuses all three modalities into a single 5 × 64 × 64 × 32 5{\times}64{\times}64{\times}32 latent grid, preserving the exact 5,120 5{,}120 -token count of the RGB-only VAE. Because widening the latent channels from 16 16 to 32 32 only affects the initial patch-embedding and final projection layers of the DiT, WorldVAE adds a negligible + 0.0165 % +0.0165\% TFLOPs overhead.
blocks.zh: 我们首先在表1中评价世界志愿军的代表能力和计算效率。 对联合4D生成的一种天真的方法是将RGB,深度和相机射线作为单独的潜入流来表示,由于四相相自用缩放,使序列长度(15,360 15{,}360对5,120 5{,}120 DiT令牌)增加了三倍,并发生3.84×3.84\的计算起落(569.1 569.1对148.1 TFLOPs每NFE在14B DiT上). 相形之下,WorldVAE将所有三种模式都装入了单一的5×64×64×32 5×times}64×times}64×times}32 潜在网格,保留了精确的5,120 5{,}120-token计数只使用RGB的VAE. 由于将潜在通道从16个16个拓宽到32个32个仅会影响DiT的初始补丁嵌入和最终投影层,WorldVAE增加了可忽略的+0.0165%+0.0165+TFLOPs的间接费用.

blocks.en: Despite compressing four heterogeneous 4D modalities into a single compact bottleneck, WorldVAE achieves strong zero-shot round-trip reconstruction across all domains on unseen evaluation benchmarks, including MPI Sintel and the ScanNet test split: it retains high visual fidelity ( 32.23 32.23 dB PSNR, 0.888 0.888 SSIM) alongside accurate metric depth recovery ( 0.056 0.056 AbsRel, 0.984 0.984 δ 1 \delta_{1} ) and precise camera ray reconstruction ( 1.46 ∘ 1.46^{\circ} ray angular error, 1.77 ∘ 1.77^{\circ} relative rotation error). This confirms that 𝐳 4d \mathbf{z}_{\text{4d}} serves as a compact, loss-tolerant spatial language that generalizes well for downstream Any-to-4D diffusion modeling.

blocks.en: Competitive Performance Against 3D/4D Specialists. Operating in just 8 8 NFE (number of denoising steps) without global alignment, on Sintel and ScanNet, WorldLatent-14B outperforms diffusion baselines (DepthCrafter and Marigold-v1.1) and several established 3D/4D reconstruction specialists (DUSt3R, MASt3R, and MonST3R) in both depth and camera pose estimation. We conduct controlled ablations using the Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B backbone under an identical training budget to evaluate our multi-task formulation and unified latent bottleneck design (Table 4 ). In Table 4 (a), we compare our jointly trained unified model ( J ) against three separate single-task 1.3B specialists trained exclusively on perception ( P ), depth-conditioned rendering ( R ), or text-to-4D generation ( G ). While each specialist dedicates 100 % 100\% of its capacity to a single task and cannot execute the other tasks, our unified 1.3B checkpoint simultaneously handles all three task families with competitive performance across every metric (e.g., matching specialist G in text alignment at .219 .219 vs. .220 .220 CLIP-T and .945 .945 dynamic degree, and matching specialist R at .960 .960 vs. .964 .964 render δ 1 \delta_{1} ). Moreover, as demonstrated in Tables 2 and 3 , scaling the unified model from 1.3B to 14B parameters resolves this capacity bottleneck and matches or surpasses state-of-the-art specialists.

In Table 4 (b), we ablate our DPT Fusion module against a baseline that naively concatenates the four 16 16 -channel modality latents along the channel dimension into a 64 64 -channel latent space ( Separate 64-ch ). Despite using half the latent channels ( 32 32 vs. 64 64 ), our Fused 32-ch representation achieves higher depth inlier accuracy ( .777 .777 vs. .768 .768 δ 1 \delta_{1} ), lower ray direction error ( 5.03 ∘ 5.03^{\circ} vs. 5.90 ∘ 5.90^{\circ} ), lower temporal drift ( .095 .095 vs. .108 .108 ), and a substantial + 9.3 +9.3 -point improvement in camera pose AUC@30 ( .692 .692 vs. .599 .599 ). blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: We introduced WorldLatent, a unified 4D latent representation protocol that bridges world perception and generative modeling. By fusing visual appearance, geometry, and camera dynamics into a single compact WorldLatent bottleneck, our framework establishes a shared spatial language across heterogeneous 4D tasks. Building on this, our Any-to-4D diffusion formulation consolidates perception, text-to-4D generation, and controllable re-rendering into a single generative model and optimization loop. Extensive experiments validate this unified approach, laying a scalable blueprint toward general-purpose 4D spatial intelligence. While we have validated single-model 4D perception and generation at a moderate scale, the effects of industrial-scale compute, parameters, and data remain unexplored. An open question for future large-scale research is whether scaling multi-task training over a shared 4D latent space will catalyze emergent spatial and physical reasoning , analogous to the trajectory from GPT-2 [ 41 ] to modern frontier LLMs.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了WorldLatent,一个统一的4D潜在代表协议,它连接了世界的认知和基因模型. 通过将视觉外观、几何学和相机动力学融合成一个单一的紧凑的WorldLatent瓶颈,我们的框架建立了跨越各种4D任务的共享空间语言。 在此基础上,我们的Any-to-4D扩散配方整合了感知,文本-4D生成,可控再还原为单一基因模型并优化循环. 广泛的实验验证了这种统一的方法,为通用4D空间智能奠定了可扩展的蓝图. 虽然我们已经在中度规模上验证了单型4D感知和生成,但工业规模计算的效果,参数,和数据仍然没有得到探讨. 未来大规模研究的一个未决问题是,在共享的4D潜在空间上进行多任务培训是否会催化出现空间和物理推理,类似于从GPT-2[41]到现代前沿法学硕士的轨迹。

blocks.en: Multi-Domain Training Mixture. To train both WorldVAE (Stage 1) and our unified Any-to-4D diffusion model (Stage 2), we curate approximately 1.4 1.4 M 17 17 -frame video clips spanning 22 22 diverse data sources, summarized in Table 5 . Our sampling distribution balances two complementary pools: • Real-World Video Pool ( 79.4 % 79.4\% of samples): Draws from large-scale open-domain and text-video corpora (SpatialVid-HQ [ 56 ] , VidGen-1M [ 53 ] , Kinetics-600 [ 24 ] , OpenVid-1M [ 39 ] , Open-Sora [ 76 ] ), camera- and object-centric real videos (RealCam-Vid [ 74 ] , SA-V [ 44 ] , CO3D [ 45 ] ), and egocentric or robotic manipulation streams (Ego-Exo4D [ 15 ] , EgoDex [ 18 ] , HOI4D [ 35 ] , DROID [ 26 ] ). This pool provides broad open-world visual concepts, complex non-rigid motion, realistic lighting, and diverse scene coverage essential for generalizable 4D generation and editing, with dense depth and camera pose pseudo-labels generated by DA3-Giant [ 31 ] . • Labeled 3D/4D Pool ( 20.6 % 20.6\% of samples): Combines synthetic 4D datasets with exact rendering-engine depth and camera trajectories (PointOdyssey [ 75 ] , OmniWorld [ 77 ] , Hypersim [ 47 ] , TartanAir [ 60 ] , Dynamic Replica [ 23 ] , VKITTI2 [ 7 ] , MVS-Synth [ 20 ] ) alongside calibrated real-sensor 3D scans (WildRGB-D [ 63 ] , ScanNet++ [ 68 ] , Waymo Open [ 50 ] ). These datasets anchor sharp geometric boundaries, accurate occlusion disambiguation, and physically grounded 3D camera motion. Because real-sensor 3D scans often contain sensor noise and incomplete depth regions, we likewise use DA3-Giant [ 31 ] as a teacher to generate clean, dense 4D labels for them. Across both pools, we use Gemini 3.5 Flash [ 54 ] to generate uniform, high-quality text captions for all video clips. Crucially, all zero-shot perception benchmarks evaluated in the main paper, MPI Sintel [ 6 ] , Bonn RGB-D Dynamic [ 40 ] , and ScanNet [ 9 ] , as well as the 55 55 held-out clips used for generation evaluation, are strictly excluded from all Stage 1 and Stage 2 training splits.
